description: This file defines a Redux slice for managing music library state including playlists, liked songs, and recent tracks.

methods.name: setPlaylists
methods.description: Replaces all playlists in the state with a new array.

methods.name: addPlaylist
methods.description: Adds a new playlist object to the playlists array, generating an ID and timestamps.

methods.name: updatePlaylist
methods.description: Updates an existing playlist identified by id with specified changes and updates timestamp.

methods.name: removePlaylist
methods.description: Removes a playlist by its ID.

methods.name: setLikedSongs
methods.description: Replaces the entire liked songs list.

methods.name: toggleLike
methods.description: Adds or removes a track from likedSongs based on its current presence.

methods.name: addRecent
methods.description: Adds a track to the recent list, removing duplicates and maintaining a maximum length.

ctags.name: playlists
ctags.pattern: /^  playlists: [],  \/\/ [{ id, name, description, tracks: Track[], createdAt, updatedAt }]$/

fields.name: playlists: [],  \/\/ [{ id, name, description, tracks: Track[], createdAt, updatedAt }]
